title: RFI Extraction Template
description: Structured output format for parsing EU CTR Validation RFI PDF documents. Field names map directly to the node/property/relationship names already deployed in the Neo4j AuraDB instance — do not rename fields without updating the graph model too.

rfi_id.description: Unique RFI identifier as printed in the document, e.g. 'CT-2024-123456-12-00-SM01-001'. Maps to RFI.rfi_id — this is the merge key for the RFI node, must be extracted exactly as printed, no reformatting.

due_date.description: Maps to RFI.due_date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Convert from the document's dd/mm/yyyy format.

response_date.description: Maps to RFI.response_date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Use null if the document shows no response date yet.

msc.description: Maps to (RFI)-[:SUBMITTED_TO]->(MSC). Exactly one per RFI document.

country.description: The Member State Concerned as printed, e.g. 'Germany'. Maps to MSC.country — this is the merge key. Use the exact country name; do not abbreviate or translate.

indication.description: Maps to (RFI)-[:INDICATION_TO]->(Indication). The therapeutic indication the trial studies.

name.description: Therapeutic indication/disease, e.g. 'Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus'. Maps to Indication.name — merge key. Use full standard naming, not abbreviations, so records referencing the same indication merge correctly.

considerations.description: Maps to (RFI)-[:HAS_CONSIDERATION]->(Consideration). Create ONE array entry per distinct 'Consideration number' block found in the document — do not merge multiple considerations into a single entry, and do not split one consideration across multiple entries.

number.description: Maps to Consideration.number. Taken directly from the document's 'Consideration number' field.

concern_text.description: The actual concern/question raised by the reviewer, extracted verbatim from the document's 'Consideration:' field. Maps to Consideration.concern_text. This is distinct from response.text (the sponsor's reply) and ctr_article.name (the section referenced) — without this field, semantic search can only match against responses, not the underlying concerns themselves.

name.description: The section/article/annex referenced by this specific consideration, e.g. 'Annex I, Section 63' or 'Article 6'. Maps to CTRArticle.name — merge key. If the document doesn't explicitly name an article/section for this consideration, infer the closest matching Annex I section from the 'Application section' field, but flag inferred values separately if possible.

text.description: The sponsor's response text for this consideration, extracted verbatim from the 'Sponsor response' field. Maps to Response.text.

outcome.description: Maps to (Consideration)-[:STATUS]->(Outcome). Optional — validation-stage RFI documents typically do NOT state whether a response was accepted, so this will usually be null at extraction time and populated later from a separate follow-up document if available.
